rules: Prefer editing the current Spark when it can satisfy the request.
Never replace a Spark for copy-only, media-only, repeater CRUD, or bounded visual-token changes.
For repeater CRUD, discover the existing collection key and preserve sibling item schema.
Adding an item clones the nearest valid item shape, then applies only requested fields.
Removing an item must target an explicit item index or uniquely matched item label/title.
Element edits apply only to resolved matched paths.
Unknown edit keys are rejected rather than silently inserted.
A structural layout/media capability change may replace the Spark only when the current Spark cannot represent it.
Preserve type, render key, dynamic bindings, and unrelated fields.
